mcp__t3_code__t3_preview_list
toolContracts.description:
List this thread's preview tabs. Only `runtime:'server'` entries can be automated here. Others are in the user's local desktop app. Never pass a non-server `tabId` to a `preview_*` tool. Tell the user that tab is on their local desktop and this environment cannot reach it.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__t3_code__t3_preview_list(args: { cursor?: number; limit?: number; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ nextCursor: number | null; revision: number; serverEpoch: string; sessions: Array<{ automationOwner?: string | null; canGoBack: boolean; canGoForward: boolean; colorScheme?: "system" | "light" | "dark" | null; headless?: boolean | null; navStatus: { _tag: "Idle"; [key: string]: unknown; } | { _tag: "Loading"; title: string; url: string; [key: string]: unknown; } | { _tag: "Success"; title: string; url: string; [key: string]: unknown; } | { _tag: "LoadFailed"; code: number; description: string; download?: { fileName: string; id: string; [key: string]: unknown; } | null; title: string; url: string; [key: string]: unknown; }; profileId?: string | null; reveal?: boolean | null; revealRequest?: { force: boolean; id: string; [key: string]: unknown; } | null; runtime?: "desktop" | "server" | null; tabId: string; threadId: string; updatedAt: string; viewport?: { _tag: "fill"; [key: string]: unknown; } | { _tag: "freeform"; height: number; width: number; [key: string]: unknown; } | { _tag: "preset"; height: number; presetId: "iphone-se" | "iphone-xr" | "iphone-12-pro" | "iphone-14-pro-max" | "pixel-7" | "samsung-galaxy-s8-plus" | "samsung-galaxy-s20-ultra" | "ipad-mini" | "ipad-air" | "ipad-pro" | "surface-pro-7" | "surface-duo" | "galaxy-z-fold-5" | "asus-zenbook-fold" | "samsung-galaxy-a51-71" | "nest-hub" | "nest-hub-max" | "desktop-1920x1080" | "desktop-1440x900" | "laptop-1366x768" | "laptop-1280x800" | "ipad-pro-11" | "iphone-15-pro" | "pixel-8" | "galaxy-s24"; width: number; [key: string]: unknown; } | null; zoomFactor?: 0.25 | 0.33 | 0.5 | 0.67 | 0.75 | 0.8 | 0.9 | 1 | 1.1 | 1.25 | 1.5 | 1.75 | 2 | 2.5 | 3 | 4 | 5 | null; [key: string]: unknown; }>; [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```

mcp__t3_code__t3_thread_organize
toolContracts.description:
Pin, snooze, settle, archive, or mark a thread unread. Omit `threadId` for this thread. `snooze` needs `snoozedUntil`. Settling this thread applies at turn end. A failed turn or queued message leaves it active.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__t3_code__t3_thread_organize(args: { action: "pin" | "unpin" | "snooze" | "unsnooze" | "settle" | "unsettle" | "archive" | "unarchive" | "mark_unread"; environmentId?: string; snoozedUntil?: string; threadId?: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

toolContracts.name: mcp__t3_code__t3_thread_update
toolContracts.description:
Rename a thread (`action:'rename'` with `title`) or regenerate its title. Omit `threadId` for this thread. Workspace and branch cannot change here.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__t3_code__t3_thread_update(args: { action: "rename" | "regenerate_title"; clientRequestId?: string; environmentId?: string; threadId?: string; title?: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ action: "rename" | "regenerate_title"; commandId: string; linkedPullRequest: { number: number; projectId: string; repository: string; url: string; [key: string]: unknown; } | null; sequence: number; threadId: string; title: string; titleRegeneration: { requestId: string; startedAt: string; [key: string]: unknown; } | null; updatedAt: string; [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```
